description: Exceptions are classes; `except X` matches instances of `X` and of every subclass.
One class (here `AppError`) that every error a library raises on purpose derives from, so callers can catch them all in one clause.
The first matching `except` wins, so specific classes are listed before their bases.
`else` runs only when the `try` body raised nothing; `finally` runs in every case.
`LookupError`, `OSError`, `ValueError` and `ArithmeticError` group related built-in errors; domain errors can join a family through multiple inheritance.
